name: Path Forsaken
descriptionTemplate: {Team Unique}: After the wielder deals Active DMG, there is a [StateArg1]% chance to draw 1 of their Command Cards and reduce its Arithmetica Cost by 1. This effect activates only once per turn.
lore:
The girl opens her eyes and finds herself surrounded by darkness.

"Hey!" she shouts. "Is anyone there?"
Her voice wavers and fades into the boundless space. She takes a deep breath and calls out again.
"Sister? Brown? West-whelp?"
"Is anyone there...?"

Her second question, louder than the first, drifts away and slowly returns. The echo seems to draw in strands of bluish light from the distance. Countless dust-like particles hover in the air, winding like serpents and rising and falling like waves.
A continuous stream of light sweeps past the motionless girl, quickly transforming the entire realm into a sea of stars. The tiny particles slip through her fingers and hair, leaving no trace behind.

"What is this...?"
The glowing dust undulates gently around her but offers no answer.
"I remember the wax museum. I remember my sister. I... think I died. Is this heaven?"
She looks around.
"Why isn't there even an angel here? This can't be hell, can it?"
Her voice dies beside her ear. This time, even the echo fails to return.

An inexplicable loneliness rises from deep within her heart. Dazed, she feels as though she has returned to the time before she met her sister and Brown.
The foul stench of the dark sewer fills the air. She is cold and hungry, yet unable to escape. Someone had pushed her down, and a large barrel had been placed over the sewer, trapping her beneath it.
She slaps her face and steps forward.
The dust parts before her, then gathers behind her.

Lift a leg. Set it down.
Lift a leg. Set it down.

She continues walking, unsure how much time has passed or how far she has gone. Ahead lie only more dust and darkness. Behind her, the direction she came from and the path she has walked have vanished without a trace.
Until—

"You've been awakened... Jenkin? Jenkin, can you hear me?"
